2609.26621.title: Greedy Decoding Is Not Precision-Invariant: Cross-Precision Output Divergence in LLM Inference
2609.26621.paper_summary: Greedy decoding from large language models is commonly treated as deterministic. We show it is not precision-invariant: the same model, prompt, and decoding algorithm produce different outputs in BF16 versus FP16 on identical hardware. Across our evaluations of six models (1.1B-7B parameters, four families; divergence additionally characterised at 12B) and three benchmarks, 49-100\% of prompts diverge; a single token flip often cascades into trajectory-level divergence. We develop an empirical error-propagation analysis and find that 22 layers of accumulated body error do not distinguish flipping from non-flipping steps; the outcome depends primarily on the top-two logit margin at the LM head relative to the directional perturbation between the top-two candidates. The analysis makes five testable predictions about intervention outcomes, including that applying more FP32 compute (broader scope) makes agreement worse. The experiments match all five predictions. The best-performing low-overhead intervention we evaluate, selective FP32 LM head recomputation, triggered only when the margin falls below a threshold, delivers +22-36 pp exact agreement on A10G (+12-21 pp on L4 and A100) at less than 4\% latency overhead in low-batch (batch size <=4) single-stream inference. We map the applicability boundary across six models and four batch sizes, and hypothesise that training-time precision stability is a determining factor. The method is a partial mitigation rather than a universal determinism guarantee: its benefit vanishes when body-originated error dominates, including at batch size >=8 and under end-to-end FP8 in our tests.
2609.26621.paper_summary_zh: 貪婪解碼在大型語言模型中通常被視為確定性的。我們顯示它不是精度不變的：相同的模型、提示和解碼算法在相同硬體上以BF16和FP16產生不同的輸出。在我們對六個模型（1.1B-7B參數，四個家族；在12B時進一步表徵的發散）和三個基準的評估中，49-100\%的提示出現發散；單一的標記翻轉常常會引發軌跡級別的發散。我們開發了一種經驗誤差傳播分析，發現22層累積的主體誤差無法區分翻轉步驟和非翻轉步驟；結果主要依賴於LM頭部的前兩個logit邊際相對於前兩個候選者之間的方向擾動。該分析對干預結果提出了五項可檢驗的預測，包括應用更多FP32計算（更廣泛的範圍）會使一致性變差。實驗與所有五項預測相符。我們評估的最佳低開銷干預，選擇性FP32 LM頭部重新計算，僅在邊際低於閾值時觸發，在低批次（批次大小 <=4）單流推理中提供了A10G上+22-36 pp的精確一致性（在L4和A100上+12-21 pp），延遲開銷不到4\%。我們映射了六個模型和四個批次大小的適用邊界，並假設訓練時的精度穩定性是決定因素。該方法是一種部分緩解，而不是普遍確定性的保證：當主體來源的誤差主導時，其益處會消失，包括在批次大小 >=8和在我們的測試中端到端FP8下。
